tools.name: talenthr_list_employees
tools.description: List the company's employees from the TalentHR directory with name, e-mail, job title, department, division, location, employment status, manager id, hire date and phone. Paged (limit max 100): use next_offset to continue. Filter by location, department, division or employment status (emp_state) wit

tools.name: talenthr_get_directory_filters
tools.description: List the valid filter options (departments, divisions, locations, employment statuses) with their ids, to build the `filter` argument of talenthr_list_employees and talenthr_get_calendar.

tools.name: talenthr_get_employee
tools.description: Get one employee's profile: birth date, hire and termination date, personal e-mail, work phone, address, nationality, gender, job title, department, division, location, role, seniority and custom fields. Contains sensitive personal data (it can include the SSN); only fetch it when the user asked abo

tools.name: talenthr_get_employee_job
tools.description: Get one employee's job information: employment status history, manager records, job records (title, department, location over time), compensation records and benefits. Compensation is sensitive; only fetch it when the user asked.

tools.name: talenthr_get_organization_chart
tools.description: List all current employees with their manager (reports_to_employee_id), job title and role, to answer who reports to whom.

tools.name: talenthr_list_departments
tools.description: List all departments of the company with their ids (the ids are what talenthr_list_employees filters and employee records refer to).

tools.name: talenthr_list_divisions
tools.description: List all divisions of the company with their ids (the ids are what talenthr_list_employees filters and employee records refer to).

tools.name: talenthr_list_locations
tools.description: List all locations (with address and remote flag) of the company with their ids (the ids are what talenthr_list_employees filters and employee records refer to).

tools.name: talenthr_list_job_titles
tools.description: List all job titles of the company with their ids (the ids are what talenthr_list_employees filters and employee records refer to).

tools.name: talenthr_list_time_off_types
tools.description: List the time off types (vacation, sick leave, ...) with id, yearly budget, whether approval is needed and whether it is paid. The id is needed to book a request with talenthr_create_time_off_request.

tools.name: talenthr_list_employee_time_off_requests
tools.description: List one employee's time off requests (dates, type, days, approved or pending, canceled). Paged: use next_offset to continue. A request with approved=null is still pending.

tools.name: talenthr_get_employee_time_off_budgets
tools.description: Get one employee's time off budgets per type and cycle: budget, original budget, used days and accrual figures, i.e. how many days they have left. Optionally limit to the current cycle (active) or one cycle id.

tools.name: talenthr_get_calendar
tools.description: Who is off when: employees with their time off requests and the holidays for a date range. Without end_date the range runs to the end of the start month (max 2 years). Without a filter it includes every employee (also terminated). Filter with keys time_off (pending, approved), department, division,

tools.name: talenthr_list_holidays
tools.description: List the company holidays of a year (current year by default) with date and who they apply to.

tools.name: talenthr_list_benefits
tools.description: List the company's benefits with category, cost, dates and who they are required for. Optional `filter` with keys location, department, division, job_title, emp_state and employee (e.g. location=36;emp_state=1,2).

tools.name: talenthr_get_employee_benefits
tools.description: List the benefits one employee has (category, cost, start and end date).

tools.name: talenthr_list_assets
tools.description: List the company's assets (laptops, phones, subscriptions, memberships) with status, category, serial number, cost, purchase and warranty dates. Paged: use next_offset to continue. `search` matches name, description or category; `filter` takes status and category ids (e.g. status=1,2;category=19).

tools.name: talenthr_get_employee_assets
tools.description: List the assets (inventory and memberships) assigned to one employee. Paged: use next_offset to continue.

tools.name: talenthr_list_job_positions
tools.description: List the company's job positions (open and closed) with title, status, location, department, publish date and the hiring steps. The id is used to list a position's applicants.

tools.name: talenthr_list_job_position_applicants
tools.description: List the applicants of one job position with contact data, current hiring step and whether they are disqualified. Paged: use next_offset to continue. `search` matches first name, last name and e-mail.

tools.name: talenthr_list_applicants
tools.description: List every candidate across all job positions with contact data and the number of applications. Paged: use next_offset to continue. `search` matches first name, last name and e-mail; `starred_only` returns only the starred candidates (the talent pool).

tools.name: talenthr_get_applicant
tools.description: Get one candidate with contact data, description, CV info and all applications with the hiring step each one is in. The application ids are used by talenthr_create_applicant_note.

tools.name: talenthr_get_headcount_report
tools.description: Headcount per month over a period (total and optionally grouped by gender, location, department, division, ...), plus the current headcount.

tools.name: talenthr_get_hires_leaves_report
tools.description: Hires, terminations and attrition rate per month over a period.

tools.name: talenthr_get_time_off_report
tools.description: Approved, non-canceled time off summarized per month and per weekday, split by time off type, for a period.

tools.name: talenthr_list_time_tracking_entries
tools.description: List time tracking entries across all employees (start, end, duration, tags) for a period or date range. Paged: use next_offset to continue. working_now=true lists only running timers. Needs a key whose user may see everyone's time tracking.

tools.name: talenthr_create_time_off_request
tools.description: WRITE: book a time off request for an employee (talenthr_list_time_off_types gives the type id). tools.name: talenthr_reply_time_off_request
tools.description: WRITE: approve (accept=true) or reject (accept=false) a pending time off request. TalentHR automatically E-MAILS THE EMPLOYEE the decision. A request that was already answered or canceled cannot be answered again. Only do this when the user explicitly asked for that decision on that request (find id

tools.name: talenthr_create_applicant_note
tools.description: WRITE: add an internal note to a job application (visible to the hiring team in TalentHR; no one is e-mailed). Needs the job position id and the application id (talenthr_get_applicant lists an applicant's applications with their job_position_id). Notes cannot be edited or deleted through this server
